name: Earthen Hearts
source:
A vacation gone wrong leads you into a ghost-island, where you meet its otherworldly inhabitants. Will you befriend them, or focus on escaping? 

[From [url=https://yerdad.itch.io/earthen-hearts-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次出了岔子的假期，将你带到了一座幽灵岛上，你在那里遇见了来自另一个世界的居民。你会与他们交朋友，还是一心寻找逃离的方法？

[摘自[url=https://yerdad.itch.io/earthen-hearts-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
